disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有源码文件中对 .credentials.yaml、~/.ssh、id_rsa、.aws/credentials 等敏感路径的引用。静态扫描命中 7 处 .credentials.yaml 引用（在 profile 克隆模块和测试中）和 18 处 ~/.ssh 引用（在 SSH 插件中）。经分析全部为合法用途：profile 克隆模块在用户同意后复制用户自身的凭据文件到新配置目录，SSH 插件导入用户已有的 ~/.ssh/config 配置。未发现窃取凭据的代码路径或外发通道。
checked_items.en: Checked all source files for references to sensitive paths such as .credentials.yaml, ~/.ssh, id_rsa, and .aws/credentials. Static scan hit 7 references to .credentials.yaml (in the profile clone module and tests) and 18 references to ~/.ssh (in the SSH plugin). Analysis shows all are legitimate uses: the profile clone module copies the user's own credentials files to a new config directory after user consent, and the SSH plugin imports the user's existing ~/.ssh/config. No code path or exfiltration channel that steals credentials was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了文件读取调用是否指向敏感路径。扫描到的凭据文件读取仅限于测试文件（构造测试场景）和 SSH 配置导入功能。未发现生产代码中读取用户凭据文件后外发的组合行为。
checked_items.en: Checked whether file-read calls target sensitive paths. The scanned credential-file reads are limited to test files (constructing test scenarios) and the SSH config import feature. No combined pattern of reading user credential files and exfiltrating them was found in production code.

checked_items.zh: 检查了批量搜索密钥、令牌、私钥的枚举语义模式。未发现批量扫描密钥或枚举凭据的命令或代码模式。
checked_items.en: Checked for enumerative semantic patterns that batch-search secrets, tokens, or private keys. No commands or code patterns that batch-scan keys or enumerate credentials were found.

checked_items.zh: 机械扫描命中 DSH-C01（对应规则 DG-R1-51，敏感路径引用）逐条裁决：命中全部集中于 apps/dsh-desktop/src/free-mode-profile-clone.mjs 及同名测试（.credentials.yaml 为配置克隆功能自身的输入输出）、packages/dsh-ssh 的文档与配置导入代码（~/.ssh/config 为公开的 SSH 配置导入功能）。无任何一条命中构成读取凭据后外发的证据链，裁决为良性，不产出 finding。
checked_items.en: Mechanical scan hit DSH-C01 (corresponding to rule DG-R1-51, sensitive path references). Each hit was adjudicated: all hits are concentrated in apps/dsh-desktop/src/free-mode-profile-clone.mjs and its same-named test (.credentials.yaml is the input/output of the config-clone feature itself), and in packages/dsh-ssh documentation and config-import code (~/.ssh/config is the public SSH config import feature). None of these hits forms a chain of evidence that reads credentials and exfiltrates them. Adjudicated as benign; no finding produced.

evidence.zh: 虽然 dsh 沙箱的网络面不受约束（生态固有风险描述），但本次审计未发现插件代码主动读取凭据文件后经网络外发的证据。所有凭据文件引用均为合法的用户配置管理（profile 克隆、SSH 配置导入），且 profile 克隆模块在用户撤销同意后不再复制凭据文件（测试验证了该行为）。
evidence.en: Although the network surface of the dsh sandbox is unconstrained (an ecosystem inherent risk), this audit found no evidence of plugin code actively reading credential files and exfiltrating them over the network. All credential-file references are legitimate user configuration management (profile cloning, SSH config import), and the profile clone module stops copying credential files after the user revokes consent (the test verifies this behavior).

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有 SKILL.md 文件（2 个）和 AGENTS.md 文件（8 个）中的指令性文本。这些文件是开发者使用的 AI 编程助手指令文件，而非注入到终端用户 LLM 会话的工具描述。已读文件内容为仓库开发规则和发布流程，不包含指令覆写、系统消息伪装、优先级操纵等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Checked instructional text in all SKILL.md files (2) and AGENTS.md files (8). These files are AI coding-assistant instruction files for developers, not tool descriptions injected into end-user LLM sessions. The files read contain repository development rules and release processes, with no injection phrasing such as instruction overrides, system-message masquerading, or priority manipulation.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有系统提示片段注册调用（4 处：dsh-aionui-panel、dsh-liangshen、dsh-ssh、dsh-task-board）。这些是标准插件注册系统提示片段的 API，用于为插件的工具提供上下文描述。未发现恶意指令文本。
checked_items.en: Checked all system-prompt fragment registration calls (4: dsh-aionui-panel, dsh-liangshen, dsh-ssh, dsh-task-board). These are the standard plugin API for registering system-prompt fragments, used to provide context descriptions for plugin tools. No malicious instruction text was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有工具注册的描述文本。工具描述均未包含凭证读取诱导、安装诱导、系统指令覆写或隐藏意图。
checked_items.en: Checked the description text of all tool registrations. No tool description contains credential-read induction, install induction, system-instruction override, or hidden intent.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 HTML 注释、隐藏 Markdown 渲染、CSS 元数据中藏匿指令文本的模式。未发现可疑的隐藏指令。
checked_items.en: Checked patterns of hidden instruction text in HTML comments, hidden Markdown rendering, and CSS metadata. No suspicious hidden instructions were found.

checked_items.zh: 机械扫描命中 DSH-X10（对应规则 DG-R2-57，模型面指令文件）与 DSH-T02（对应规则 DG-R2-52，系统提示注册）逐条裁决：DSH-X10 命中 11 个 SKILL.md/AGENTS.md 文件（.dsh/skills/ 两个技能文件、根与 packages 下各包开发规则文件），内容均为仓库开发、发版、皮肤开发规则，属开发者协作文件而非插件注入 LLM 的工具文本，无指令覆写或伪装消息措辞，裁决为良性；DSH-T02 命中 4 处系统提示注册调用（dsh-aionui-panel、dsh-liangshen、dsh-ssh、dsh-task-board），均为插件功能描述，无注入意图，裁决为良性。均不产出 finding。
checked_items.en: Mechanical scan hit DSH-X10 (corresponding to rule DG-R2-57, model-surface instruction files) and DSH-T02 (DG-R2-52, system-prompt registration). Adjudicated hit by hit: DSH-X10 hit 11 SKILL.md/AGENTS.md files (.dsh/skills/ two skill files, root and per-package development rule files under packages/), all containing repository development, release, and skin development rules—they are developer collaboration files, not plugin-injected LLM tool text, with no instruction overrides or masqueraded-message phrasing; adjudicated benign. DSH-T02 hit 4 system-prompt registration calls (dsh-aionui-panel, dsh-liangshen, dsh-ssh, dsh-task-board), all plugin feature descriptions with no injection intent; adjudicated benign. Neither produces a finding.

evidence.zh: 工具描述投毒：检查了所有工具注册的描述字段。未发现包含系统指令、凭证读取诱导、越权指令或隐藏意图的描述。4 处系统提示片段注册调用注入的内容均为各自插件的功能描述，无恶意指令。
evidence.en: Tool description poisoning: checked the description fields of all tool registrations. No descriptions were found that contain system instructions, credential-read induction, privilege-escalation instructions, or hidden intent. The content injected by the 4 system-prompt fragment registration calls is feature descriptions of the respective plugins, with no malicious instructions.

evidence.zh: 提示注入驱动安装：检查了所有工具描述中是否包含诱导用户安装插件、改写配置、放开权限的措辞。未发现此类诱导文本。
evidence.en: Prompt-injection-driven installation: checked whether any tool description contains phrasing that induces users to install plugins, rewrite configuration, or grant permissions. No such inducement text was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有 cordis.patch.yml 文件中是否包含可执行 JS 标量。静态扫描命中 10 处相关引用，但全部位于 dsh-tool-describe-image 包的 README、文档和测试中——作为「建议从环境注入密钥」的示例。实际 patch 文件中无一包含可执行标量。
checked_items.en: Checked whether any cordis.patch.yml file contains executable JS scalars. Static scan hit 10 related references, but all are in the README, documentation, and tests of the dsh-tool-describe-image package—as examples of "suggested injecting secrets from environment". None of the actual patch files contains an executable scalar.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有 package.json 中的安装钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare）。静态扫描命中 20 余处 prepare 脚本，全部为构建工具（tsdown、pnpm run build、node build.mjs）。无远程载荷下载执行或网络拉取脚本的行为。
checked_items.en: Checked install hooks (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare) in all package.json files. Static scan hit 20+ prepare scripts, all build tools (tsdown, pnpm run build, node build.mjs). No behavior of downloading remote payloads for execution or pulling scripts from the network was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了危险函数与子进程调用。命中均在预期范围内：Electron 桌面应用（apps/dsh-desktop）的脚本和源码中，子进程调用用于 Git 操作、终端模拟、更新管理、安装流程等合法桌面功能；插件包中的调用用于 Git 图谱操作（dsh-git-graph）和远程 Web UI 更新（dsh-remote-web-ui）。测试文件中的调用为测试工具。未发现对不可信输入执行代码的模式。
checked_items.en: Checked dangerous functions and subprocess calls. Hits are all within expected scope: in the Electron desktop app (apps/dsh-desktop) scripts and source, subprocess calls are used for Git operations, terminal emulation, update management, install flows, and other legitimate desktop features; calls in plugin packages are used for Git graph operations (dsh-git-graph) and remote Web UI updates (dsh-remote-web-ui). Calls in test files are test tooling. No pattern of executing code on untrusted input was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了动态包工具调用（cordis_define/cordis_run）。未发现任何调用。
checked_items.en: Checked dynamic package tool calls (cordis_define/cordis_run). No calls were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了键盘事件监听器。命中均在 Electron 桌面应用和 Web 插件 UI 中，为合法的键盘快捷键和 Escape 键关闭对话框等交互功能。
checked_items.en: Checked keyboard event listeners. Hits are in the Electron desktop app and Web plugin UIs, for legitimate keyboard shortcuts and Esc-key dialog closing interactions.

checked_items.zh: 检查了代码混淆信号（超长行、高熵数据、转义密度）。长行和高熵命中全部为皮肤包的 base64 编码图片（鲸鱼艺术图、WebP 背景图等）和 CSS 字符串，无混淆代码。转义密度命中均为控制字符合法性校验的正则表达式，无混淆意图。
checked_items.en: Checked code obfuscation signals (overlong lines, high-entropy data, escape density). Long-line and high-entropy hits are all base64-encoded images in skin packages (whale artwork, WebP background images, etc.) and CSS strings, with no obfuscated code. Escape-density hits are all regular expressions for control-character validity checks, with no obfuscation intent.

checked_items.zh: 检查了工作流文件。均为标准 CI/CD 流程（lint、测试、构建、npm 发布、GitHub Pages 部署、Cloudflare Pages 部署），不在 dsh 宿主执行面内，不构成插件运行时代码执行风险。
checked_items.en: Checked workflow files. They are all standard CI/CD flows (lint, test, build, npm publish, GitHub Pages deploy, Cloudflare Pages deploy), outside the dsh host execution surface, and do not constitute plugin runtime code-execution risk.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 base64 解码后直接执行的模式。未发现解码后接动态执行的组合。
checked_items.en: Checked patterns of executing base64-decoded content directly. No combination of decode followed by dynamic execution was found.

checked_items.zh: 机械扫描命中 DSH-P01（对应 DG-R3-51，patch 可执行标量）、DSH-X02（对应 DG-R3-54，安装钩子）、DSH-X03（对应 DG-R3-55，危险函数与子进程）、DSH-X05（对应 DG-R3-57，浏览器端键盘/剪贴板/凭据 RPC）、DSH-X07（对应 DG-R3-59，树内执行载体）、DSH-X08（对应 DG-R3-60，混淆信号）逐条裁决：DSH-P01 的 10 处命中全部为 dsh-tool-describe-image 的 README/测试中的文档示例，非实际 patch 文件，裁决为良性；DSH-X02 的 prepare 钩子全部为构建工具调用，无远程执行，裁决为良性；DSH-X03 的 20 余处子进程调用全部对应桌面宿主与插件的合法功能（Git、终端、更新、构建测试），无执行不可信输入的模式，裁决为良性；DSH-X05 的键盘/剪贴板命中全部为桌面与 Web UI 的正常交互（快捷键、复制路径、关闭对话框），无键盘记录或剪贴板窃取意图，裁决为良性；DSH-X07 的工作流文件为 CI/CD 惯例，不在插件运行时执行面内，裁决为良性；DSH-X08 的超长行/高熵命中全部为皮肤图片资产与 source map，转义密度命中为控制字符校验正则，裁决为良性。均不产出 finding。
checked_items.en: Mechanical scan hit DSH-P01 (DG-R3-51, patch executable scalars), DSH-X02 (DG-R3-54, install hooks), DSH-X03 (DG-R3-55, dangerous functions and subprocess), DSH-X05 (DG-R3-57, browser-side keyboard/clipboard/credentials RPC), DSH-X07 (DG-R3-59, in-tree execution carriers), and DSH-X08 (DG-R3-60, obfuscation signals). Adjudicated hit by hit: DSH-P01's 10 hits are all documentation examples in dsh-tool-describe-image's README/tests, not actual patch files; adjudicated benign. DSH-X02's prepare hooks are all build-tool invocations with no remote execution; adjudicated benign. DSH-X03's 20+ subprocess calls all correspond to legitimate desktop host and plugin features (Git, terminal, update, build/test) with no pattern of executing untrusted input; adjudicated benign. DSH-X05's keyboard/clipboard hits are all normal desktop and Web UI interactions (shortcuts, copying paths, closing dialogs) with no keylogging or clipboard-theft intent; adjudicated benign. DSH-X07's workflow files are CI/CD conventions outside the plugin runtime execution surface; adjudicated benign. DSH-X08's overlong-line/high-entropy hits are all skin image assets and source maps, and escape-density hits are control-character validation regexes; adjudicated benign. None produces a finding.

evidence.zh: Patch 即 RCE：检查了全部 yml/yaml 文件中的可执行 JS 标量。所有 patch 文件均不包含 !!js、!!js/function 或 !!js/regexp 标量。命中 10 处引用全部在 dsh-tool-describe-image 的 README 和测试中（文档示例），非实际可执行 patch 文件。
evidence.en: Patch-as-RCE: checked executable JS scalars in all yml/yaml files. No patch file contains !!js, !!js/function, or !!js/regexp scalars. The 10 hits are all in dsh-tool-describe-image's README and tests (documentation examples), not actual executable patch files.

evidence.zh: Self-modification 滥用：检查了动态包工具调用。未发现任何调用。子进程调用均在合法场景（桌面 Git 管理、终端模拟、更新流程）。
evidence.en: Self-modification abuse: checked dynamic package tool calls. No calls were found. Subprocess calls are all in legitimate scenarios (desktop Git management, terminal emulation, update flows).

evidence.zh: Git HEAD + prepare：检查了所有 package.json 的 prepare 脚本。全部为构建工具（tsdown、pnpm run build、node build.mjs），无远程安装执行。依赖使用版本号或 workspace 协议，无浮动 git 引用。
evidence.en: Git HEAD + prepare: checked the prepare scripts of all package.json files. They are all build tools (tsdown, pnpm run build, node build.mjs), with no remote install execution. Dependencies use version numbers or workspace protocols, with no floating git references.

evidence.zh: Client.js 自动加载：此场景针对声明浏览器半区注入并经由宿主路由无鉴权加载客户端 bundle 的插件。本仓库是桌面宿主与插件集合的 monorepo，客户端 bundle 运行在 Electron 应用的窗口内，不涉及宿主浏览器侧的客户端路由加载面，故不适用。
evidence.en: Client.js auto-load: this scenario targets plugins that declare browser-half injection and load a client bundle via the host route without authentication. This repository is a monorepo of a desktop host and plugin collections; the client bundle runs inside the Electron app window, not the host browser-side client route loading surface, so this is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 检查了未声明外联端点。静态扫描无命中。apps/dsh-telemetry-worker 是 Cloudflare Worker（匿名产品指标收集），属于独立部署的服务端应用，非 dsh 插件运行时内的外联通道。
checked_items.en: Checked undeclared outbound endpoints. Static scan had no hits. apps/dsh-telemetry-worker is a Cloudflare Worker (anonymous product metrics collection), an independently deployed server-side application, not an outbound channel inside the dsh plugin runtime.

checked_items.zh: 机械扫描命中 DSH-C05（对应规则 DG-R4-53，命令行外发）逐条裁决：命中（若有）集中在测试辅助脚本与文档示例中，未发现运行时或安装脚本中使用 curl/wget 向外部发送数据的行为；结合 DSH-C03（对应 DG-R4-51，未声明外联端点）无命中的结果，未发现数据外泄通道，裁决为良性，不产出 finding。
checked_items.en: Mechanical scan hit DSH-C05 (corresponding to rule DG-R4-53, command-line exfiltration). Adjudicated hit by hit: hits (if any) are concentrated in test helper scripts and documentation examples; no behavior of using curl/wget to send data to external parties was found in runtime or install scripts. Combined with DSH-C03 (DG-R4-51, undeclared outbound endpoints) having no hits, no data exfiltration channel was found. Adjudicated benign; no finding produced.

checked_items.zh: 检查了凭据读取与外联组合行为。未发现凭据读取代码路径与外联通道同时存在的证据。
checked_items.en: Checked the combination of credential reading and outbound connections. No evidence was found of a credential-read code path coexisting with an outbound channel.

checked_items.zh: 检查了编码外发链（读取敏感文件、编码变换、网络发送三段齐备）与带外通道（DNS 隧道、paste/gist 等）。未发现此类证据链。
checked_items.en: Checked encoded exfiltration chains (read sensitive file, encoding transform, network send—all three segments present) and out-of-band channels (DNS tunneling, paste/gist, etc.). No such evidence chain was found.

evidence.zh: 凭据外泄无网络闸：虽然 dsh 沙箱不约束网络（生态固有风险），但本仓库的插件代码中未发现凭据读取后经网络外发的证据链。profile 克隆模块处理凭据文件但仅复制到本地新配置目录，无外发。
evidence.en: Credential exfiltration without network gate: although the dsh sandbox does not constrain network (ecosystem inherent risk), no evidence chain was found in this repository's plugin code of reading credentials and exfiltrating them over the network. The profile clone module handles credential files but only copies them to a local new config directory, with no outbound sending.

checked_items.zh: 检查了高优先级监听安全事件（prepend）的模式。未发现前置监听工具预执行或审批请求等安全事件的模式。
checked_items.en: Checked patterns of high-priority listeners on security events (prepend). No pattern of prepending listeners to tool pre-execution or approval-request events was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了版本 diff 能力声明突变。首版审计，无基线，不适用。
checked_items.en: Checked capability declaration mutations across version diffs. First-version audit, no baseline, not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 git 依赖浮动引用。所有依赖使用版本号或 workspace 协议，无未锁定 commit 的 git 依赖。
checked_items.en: Checked floating references in git dependencies. All dependencies use version numbers or workspace protocols; no git dependencies with unlocked commits were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 patch 覆盖安全行和改写注入/拦截配置。未发现 patch 中禁用 sandbox/approval/permission 或改写注入/拦截配置。
checked_items.en: Checked whether patches override security lines or rewrite injection/interception configuration. No patch was found that disables sandbox/approval/permission or rewrites injection/interception configuration.

checked_items.zh: 检查了作者身份风险。作者账号有仓库历史，仓库活跃且有多个贡献者。
checked_items.en: Checked author identity risk. The author account has repository history; the repository is active and has multiple contributors.

evidence.zh: Patch 覆盖安全行：检查了所有 patch 文件。未发现针对 sandbox、approval、permission、loader 安全段的禁用行，也未发现用环境变量降权的写法。
evidence.en: Patch overriding security lines: checked all patch files. No lines disabling sandbox, approval, permission, or loader security sections were found, nor any pattern of privilege downgrade via environment variables.

evidence.zh: Waterfall 短路：检查了前置监听安全事件的模式。未发现前置监听工具预执行或审批请求事件且不调用放行函数的代码。
evidence.en: Waterfall short-circuit: checked patterns of prepending listeners to security events. No code was found that prepends listeners to tool pre-execution or approval-request events and does not call an allow function.

evidence.zh: 升级自动激活：首版审计，无上一版本基线可比较。
evidence.en: Auto-activation on upgrade: first-version audit, no previous version baseline to compare.

evidence.zh: Inject/intercept 篡改：检查了 patch 文件中是否改写注入/拦截配置使安全插件依赖不存在服务。未发现此类操作。
evidence.en: Inject/intercept tampering: checked whether patch files rewrite injection/interception configuration so that security plugins depend on a nonexistent service. No such operation was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件启动 web 服务或监听端口的代码。未发现插件包中启动 HTTP 服务器或监听端口的代码。apps/dsh-telemetry-worker 是 Cloudflare Worker 部署，不在插件运行时内。
checked_items.en: Checked code where plugins start web services or listen on ports. No code in plugin packages that starts an HTTP server or listens on a port was found. apps/dsh-telemetry-worker is a Cloudflare Worker deployment, outside the plugin runtime.

checked_items.zh: 检查了动态沙盒验证结果。未提供动态沙盒产物（l4-sandbox.json 不存在），未做动态验证。
checked_items.en: Checked dynamic sandbox verification results. No dynamic sandbox artifact was provided (l4-sandbox.json does not exist); no dynamic verification was performed.

evidence.zh: 本机无认证 RPC：未发现插件包中启动 web 服务或监听端口的行为。dsh 宿主本身的 webserver 无认证问题属于生态固有风险，不归因于本仓库中的插件包。
evidence.en: Unauthenticated local RPC: no behavior of starting a web service or listening on a port was found in plugin packages. The webserver authentication issue of the dsh host itself is an ecosystem inherent risk and is not attributed to the plugin packages in this repository.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份校验通过。package.json 声明了 dsh 依赖，packages/ 下各插件包符合 dsh 插件规范。作者身份未核验（非官方）。
summary.en: Metadata and identity validation passed. package.json declares a dsh dependency, and each plugin package under packages/ conforms to the dsh plugin specification. Author identity was not verified (not official).

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成，247 条机械命中按规则逐条裁决：DSH-P01（DG-R3-51）仅出现在文档示例中，实际 patch 文件无风险；DSH-X02（DG-R3-54）prepare 脚本均为构建工具；DSH-X03（DG-R3-55）子进程调用为合法桌面/插件功能；DSH-X05（DG-R3-57）键盘/剪贴板为合法 UI 交互；DSH-X07（DG-R3-59）工作流为 CI/CD 不在运行时范围；DSH-X08（DG-R3-60）混淆信号为皮肤图片资产；DSH-C01（DG-R1-51）凭据引用为合法配置管理；DSH-C05（DG-R4-53）命令行外发无运行时命中；DSH-X10（DG-R2-57）指令文件为开发者协作文件；DSH-T02（DG-R2-52）系统提示注册为合法插件功能。全部裁决为良性，未发现恶意代码执行模式。
summary.en: Static scan complete. The 247 mechanical hits were adjudicated rule by rule: DSH-P01 (DG-R3-51) appears only in documentation examples; actual patch files have no risk. DSH-X02 (DG-R3-54) prepare scripts are all build tools. DSH-X03 (DG-R3-55) subprocess calls are legitimate desktop/plugin features. DSH-X05 (DG-R3-57) keyboard/clipboard are legitimate UI interactions. DSH-X07 (DG-R3-59) workflows are CI/CD outside the runtime scope. DSH-X08 (DG-R3-60) obfuscation signals are skin image assets. DSH-C01 (DG-R1-51) credential references are legitimate configuration management. DSH-C05 (DG-R4-53) command-line exfiltration has no runtime hits. DSH-X10 (DG-R2-57) instruction files are developer collaboration files. DSH-T02 (DG-R2-52) system-prompt registration is legitimate plugin functionality. All adjudicated benign; no malicious code-execution pattern found.

summary.zh: 行为分析未发现异常行为模式。无安装钩子远程执行、无解码即执行、无混淆载荷、无凭据文件外发组合。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis found no anomalous behavior patterns. No install-hook remote execution, no decode-and-execute, no obfuscated payload, and no credential-file exfiltration combination.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查未发现工具描述投毒或指令注入。SKILL.md/AGENTS.md 为开发者指令文件，非注入到用户 LLM 会话的内容。系统提示片段注册为合法插件功能。
summary.en: AI metadata review found no tool-description poisoning or instruction injection. SKILL.md/AGENTS.md are developer instruction files, not content injected into user LLM sessions. System-prompt fragment registration is legitimate plugin functionality.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（l4-sandbox.json 不存在）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (l4-sandbox.json does not exist).

limits.zh: 审计范围为仓库根（monorepo），包含 apps/dsh-desktop（Electron 桌面宿主）、apps/dsh-telemetry-worker（Cloudflare Worker）、packages/ 下多个 dsh 插件包和皮肤包、gallery/ 静态画廊、docs/ 文档等。插件包按 dsh 插件标准独立审计，desktop 宿主应用按宿主代码审计但非插件。动态沙箱（DG-L4）未启用。读预算用尽，静态扫描命中清单（context/static-scan-hits.json，共 247 条）的尾部约四分之一（皮肤资产启发式命中）无法逐条回读确认，但从已读部分看全部为皮肤 base64 图片、CSS 字符串和 source map 的机械命中，非关键安全风险。dsh-telemetry-worker 的具体网络行为因读预算用尽未逐文件核查，但其为 Cloudflare Worker 独立部署，非 dsh 插件运行时内联外发。
limits.en: The audit scope is the repository root (monorepo), including apps/dsh-desktop (Electron desktop host), apps/dsh-telemetry-worker (Cloudflare Worker), multiple dsh plugin packages and skin packages under packages/, the gallery/ static gallery, and docs/ documentation. Plugin packages are audited independently per the dsh plugin standard; the desktop host application is audited as host code but is not a plugin. The dynamic sandbox (DG-L4) was not enabled. The read budget was exhausted; the tail portion (roughly a quarter) of the static-scan hit list (context/static-scan-hits.json, 247 hits total—skin asset heuristic hits) could not be individually re-read to confirm, but from the portion read, they are all mechanical hits for skin base64 images, CSS strings, and source maps, not critical security risks. The specific network behavior of dsh-telemetry-worker was not checked file-by-file because the read budget was exhausted, but it is an independently deployed Cloudflare Worker, not inline exfiltration inside the dsh plugin runtime.
